CAREERS

# build your future at neostella.

At Neostella, we believe great work starts with great people. We’re committed to helping you grow, make an impact, and build a career you’re proud of. Explore opportunities to join our team and take the next step in your career.

[Bring your whole self](https://neostella.com/careers/#careers)

WHY NEOSTELLA

## do work that matters. grow with people who care.

We’ve built our culture around five values that shape how we work,

how we support one another, and how we show up every day.

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Neostella-Icons-On-Dark_Visibility-on-white.svg)

#### clarity

We keep things focused and simple because great work starts with knowing what matters.

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Neostella-Icons-On-Dark_Automation-on-white.svg)

#### courage

We’re not afraid to ask “What if?” We have the courage to find better ways forward.

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Neostella-Icons-On-Dark_Trust-white-1.svg)

#### care

We value empathy, collaboration, and respect, because taking care of our people makes us better at what we do.

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Neostella-Icons-On-Dark_Partnerships-2-07.svg)

#### trust

We give our teammates the confidence to take ownership, speak up, and count on one another.

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Neostella-Icons-On-Dark_Analytics-and-reporting-on-white.svg)

#### growth

We encourage curiosity, share what we learn, and create opportunities for people to stretch their skills. When one of us grows, we all get better.

COMPANY VALUES

## eight values, one way of working.

Neostella follows eight values shaped around work ethic, customer experience, and company culture:

COMPANY VALUES

## think like a customer.

Neostella builds for the real world of legal operations. Every decision is made with the hope value, clarity, and impact translates for our customers and partners.

COMPANY VALUES

## work effectively.

We take responsibility for what we build, how we support it, and the outcomes we create. When something can be better, we step up and make it better.

COMPANY VALUES

## transparency builds trust.

We communicate openly, honestly, and directly—especially when challenges arise. Trust is earned at Neostella through clarity, accountability, and consistency.

COMPANY VALUES

## simplify the complex.

Neostella wants to remove friction, not create it. We design our systems with intuitivity, connectability, scalability, and ease of use.

COMPANY VALUES

## build what changes the industry.

We challenge the status quo, rethink what legal software can be, and push the industry forward through innovation.

COMPANY VALUES

## partnership over transactions.

Neostella succeeds when our customers succeed. We show up, stay engaged, and grow alongside the firms and teams that trust us.

COMPANY VALUES

## excellence without ego.

We hold a high bar for execution while staying collaborative, humble, and focused on solutions. Great work happens when we build it together.

COMPANY VALUES

## enjoy your work.

At Neostella, we celebrate wins, move fast, stay curious, and create an environment where people genuinely enjoy building together.
